name: Metropolitan Packaging Manufacturing

about:
Metropolitan Packaging Manufacturing operates from Brooklyn, New York. The company has been producing polyethylene bags and film for over 50 years, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not stated in available sources.

The company manufactures polyethylene bags and film using printing presses and bag-making machines, regularly adding new attachments for custom packaging. It also offers stock bags. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are disclosed.

Metropolitan Packaging serves a broad range of industries and service-oriented companies, but specific sectors or customer examples are not provided in the source material.

The company emphasizes long-term customer relationships, reliable quoting, on-time delivery, and adherence to precise specifications and quantities as its operating philosophy.
